data.name: Gaean Communion
data.description: While maintaining psionic focus, you gain the ability to telepathically communicate with any animal or magical beast with an intelligence of 1 or 2 within 100 ft.  Any time you cast summon nature's ally, you can communicate telepathically with all of the creatures summoned by the spell.
